sources.name: glenngabe
sources.excerpt: AI Mode and Ads -> I'm still not seeing any ads in AI Mode when using Personal Intelligence... but I'm seeing plenty of ads in AI Mode incognito. Check out this search for windows laptops with an ad weaved into the product list... and then a larger ad module at the bottom. And check out the small disclaimer there in the weaved ad: "AI can make mistakes... make sure to double check responses. Advertisers don't see your conversations or control AI responses." If AI Mode is going to become the default at some point, then Google will need to monetize that heavily (and in a smart way). I am NOT a fan of the weaving of ads into the organic response like that... but I'm sure we will see much more…

sources.name: lilyraynyc
sources.excerpt: Probably a hot take: While it’s impressive how quickly LLMs can spin up websites, I think AI is accelerating a trend that’s been happening for years: the internet is starting to look increasingly self-similar. AI tools often generate websites using the same design patterns, layouts, fonts, and aesthetics. So many new vibe-coded apps, company websites, and landing pages are starting to look identical (not to mention the content). I’m not saying AI-generated websites look bad - they often look great. But when everything looks the same, differentiation becomes more valuable. I have a feeling that as AI-generated websites become the norm, websites and online experiences with a unique aesthetic,…
